highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews Skia m156 alongside GPU-backed GTK4 views.
highlights_body: Linux NoDependencies packages regain system-font discovery, and WebAssembly assets align with .NET 11. GTK4 high-density painting and Tizen support have new requirements; review the migration guidance before upgrading.

breaking.title: GTK4 raster painting defaults to physical pixels
breaking.body: SKDrawingArea now allocates high-density backing storage and reports physical pixels through CanvasSize and paint Info by default. Set IgnorePixelScaling to true to retain logical painting coordinates; RawInfo still describes physical pixels, and GTK input coordinates remain logical.

breaking.title: Tizen packages require Tizen 10
breaking.body: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp Tizen native packages now target net10.0-tizen10.0 and no longer support Tizen 8 or 9. Retarget applications to Tizen 10 and .NET 10; source builders need the Tizen 10 SDK and GCC 14.2 for x64 or arm64.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m156 without adding managed bindings. HarfBuzzSharp advances to package revision 14.4.0.100 while the native HarfBuzz engine remains at 14.4.0.

SKGLArea adds PaintSurface, a view-owned GRContext, optional continuous rendering and pixel-scaling control using GTK's GL context. Manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy, which dispatches GL calls for the active context.

Finds installed fonts through the directory-backed default manager without requiring fontconfig. The default search root is /usr/share/fonts/, restoring family lookup and avoiding SKShaper failures caused by empty typefaces when fonts are installed.
SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp select Emscripten 6.0.2 archives for net11 and later, including threading and SIMD variants. .NET 8 retains 3.1.34 assets, while .NET 9 and 10 retain 3.1.56.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored system-font discovery in Linux NoDependencies packages

preview_summaries.v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10: Preview 1 introduces Skia m156, native GTK4 GPU rendering and restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery. It aligns WebAssembly assets with .NET 11 and raises Tizen packages to Tizen 10.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp selects Emscripten 6.0.2 assets for .NET 11 and later and raises its Tizen packages to net10.0-tizen10.0. Windows native builds also align their selected compiler and Spectre CRT versions.

v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews Skia m156 and native GTK4 GPU rendering.
v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.body: Linux NoDependencies packages regain directory-backed system-font discovery, and WebAssembly assets align with .NET 11. Review the release notes for GTK4 pixel-scaling changes and the new Tizen 10 requirement.
